meta.shape_note: top-level object since 2026-10-04 (was a bare 14-row array); the 14 ask rows are preserved with original fields intact, additions appended per row

caveats.ds_cap: the ds arm banked here ran max_tokens 2000 (a quarter of the deepseek-chat vendor default, 8K non-thinking / 393216 ceiling per api-docs.deepseek.com/api/create-chat-completion) plus a content[:6000] store slice; 13/14 ds outputs stopped at exactly 6000 chars, so the published ds 0/26 measured the cap, not capability (a05-delta-study#0/#9). Override and slice deleted 2026-10-04; the arm re-fired uncapped as memory/runs/ds_batches/frontier_delta_results_v3.jsonl (14/14 ok_material, 0 rows at 6000 chars)
caveats.flash_file_access_asymmetry: the flash arm ran as a seat with live repo access; 97/115 WIRE_PLAN and 69/81 THE_ROOM_REMEMBERS citations appear only in flash outputs, and 7/7 spot-checked flash-only cites resolve to real file:line bytes (a05-delta-study#2) - the comparison measures harness shape as much as capability
caveats.gaming_corpus_missing_arm: SUBSTANCE_gaming_corpus shipped with flash_chars 0, no replay file, and no judge lanes in the 2026-10-03 batch (39 items = 13 scenarios x 3 pairings); the judge prompt's own rule (missing = loss for that arm) makes the frontier-flash headline 9-5, not 8-5 (a05-delta-study#6)
caveats.judge_methodology: single judge, deepseek-chat, 39/39 conf=H on the 2026-10-03 batch and 27/27 conf=H on the 2026-10-04 refire batch; DELIVERABLE A for the frontier arm is the archived claude-opus-5.5 production output, not a rerun; 20/39 original rationales cite B-truncation as the loss reason, all 20 with B=deepseek
caveats.counter_rules: frontier_chars/flash_chars and unver counts reproduce from bytes; cites counts are pattern-dependent and do not (a05-delta-study#3)
